findings: Section 2 places extraction after deacidification and deamination; Table 1 is the wastewater feed before that boundary.
Table 1 listed mass percentages alone sum to 100.230%; no silent normalization is permitted.
Table 3 gives an extraction-column operating temperature near 38 degC, but it is not a complete inlet stream specification.
Neither Table 1 nor Tables 2-7 specify the full post-pretreatment extraction inlet flow/composition/state needed by this scoped task.
No supplementary-material link or appendix group found in the retrieved publisher XML. This does not prove no author-held supplement exists.
Do not invert a heat duty to infer a unique inlet flow without qualified enthalpy, phase and composition evidence.
The indexed paper title concerns quaternary LLE, but this retrieved NIST archive contains only pure-compound property datasets.
The archive omits water and does not supply the required quaternary tie-lines or the NRTL interaction matrix.
The related 2006 DOI 10.1021/je060245c concerns MIBK/water/hydroquinone only; it is not a replacement for the full phenol/hydroquinone system.

missing_required_evidence: Post-pretreatment extraction feed mass flow, closed composition with declared basis, temperature and pressure.
Source-qualified quaternary LLE parameters and independent phase-split checks over the extraction operating domain.
Qualified downstream VLE/enthalpy and treated-water density for the mg/L specifications.
